name: Yiff Strip Stories (EP5) - "Wrong Door"
source:
Yiff Strip Stories is an adult furry visual novel, featuring Robin the Squirrel and Flint the Rabbit. Playing as Flint, you've stumbled across this poor topless squirrel, who is faced with a conundrum. Will you be able to help her?

The fifth of a series of games by Furry Outpost.  This game is a classic "unlock different scenes by making different choices" type of game. You'll be helping Robin with her situation, while making different decisions that lead to different outcomes.

[From [url=https://furryoutpost.itch.io/yiff-strip-ep5-stories]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Yiff Strip Stories是一部成人毛茸茸的视觉小说，以松鼠罗宾和兔子弗林特为主角。扮演弗林特，你偶然发现了这只可怜的裸照松鼠，它面临着一个难题。你能帮助她吗？

Furry Outpost系列游戏的第五款。该游戏是一款经典的“通过做出不同的选择来解锁不同的场景”类型的游戏。你将帮助罗宾解决她的处境，同时做出不同的决定，从而导致不同的结果。

[来自[url=https://furryoutpost.itch.io/yiff-strip-ep5-stories]itch.io[/url]]
